limitations: Rust crate-internal use/reexport paths are covered via the `mod` tree only; cross-crate reexports are not separately traced.

`membrane` binary entry (engine/crates/membrane) invoked directly by users and bundled by the Hub supervisor.

native stdio MCP session launched by generated host config
